description: Merge-patch the theme's global settings (keys from get_site.theme.theme_settings, e.g. color_primary, font_heading, radius, custom_css). null resets a key to the theme default. An outside image url in an image setting is copied into the business's media library and the setting stores our copy; if it can't be downloaded the call fails with image_fetch_failed and nothing changes.

settings.description: Merge patch on the theme's global settings

name: update_theme_settings
title: Update theme settings
